row_level_smote.note: Synthetic rows are feature-space interpolations between two possibly-different subjects' visits -- not real patients, not assignable a genuine subject_id or visit order. Fine for a flat row-level classifier like the one used for this comparison; not usable inside ADTrajectoryDataset's per-subject sequence structure without fabricating a fictitious longitudinal identity.

subject_level_duplication.note: Every duplicated row is a real recorded visit from a real subject -- no interpolation, no fabricated identity. This is the row-level analogue of oversampling.py's SubjectLevelOversampler; the actual Module B training uses the sequence-level version (whole padded subject trajectories), not this flattened row-level form.
